scholarships.title: Netaji Subhas-ICAR International Fellowship (NS-ICAR IF)
scholarships.official_source: Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt. of India

eligibility: Must hold a Master's degree in Agriculture and Allied Sciences
Must pursue a doctoral degree in agriculture and allied sciences in an identified priority area
Overseas candidates must study at an identified Indian Agricultural University in the ICAR-AU system
Indian candidates must study at an identified overseas university or institution with strong research and teaching capabilities
Must have a clear record of good conduct, certified by the Competent Authority of the university last attended or the present employer
Must provide two referees with contact email addresses who may be contacted directly by the Council
In-service Indian candidates must also furnish deputation approval from the Director of the ICAR institute or Vice-Chancellor of the Agricultural University
existing.eligibility_summary: Indian as well as overseas nationals holding a Master's degree in Agriculture and Allied Sciences who intend to pursue a doctoral degree in agriculture and allied sciences within the priority areas identified by ICAR and notified one year in advance. Overseas candidates study at Indian Agricultural Universities in the ICAR-AU system; Indian candidates study at identified overseas universities or institutions with strong research and teaching capabilities.
benefits: Three years of doctoral fellowship support
Placement at an identified host university or institute in the priority area of study
coverage: Three-year doctoral fellowship for 30 awardees per year
Support for study at a host institution in India for overseas candidates, or at an identified overseas institution for Indian candidates
requirements: The area of study and the line of the proposed research work must fall in an identified priority area relevant to Indian or global agriculture, notified one year in advance
The applicant must obtain acceptance of admission to the PhD programme at their own level, and should preferably enclose the acceptance letter with the application
The applicant should satisfy themselves about the admission and course requirements of the university before naming it as a place of study
Two referees must be provided who may be contacted directly by the Council
Selected candidates must register for the programme within one year of the fellowship award letter, or the offer is terminated automatically
documents: Completed NS-ICARIF application in the prescribed format
Two references with contact email addresses, one preferably the applicant's supervisor
Letter of acceptance for admission to the PhD degree programme in the identified area of study at the host university
Certificate of good conduct from the Competent Authority of the university last attended or the present employer
Deputation approval from the Director of the ICAR institute or Vice-Chancellor, for in-service Indian candidates
existing.english_requirement: The call, guidelines and application proforma are published by ICAR in English.
application_method: Complete the prescribed application proforma available on the ICAR website
Email the application to ADG (HRD) at adg.hrd.applications@gmail.com with the subject line "Application for NSIF: Name of Applicant and contact number"
Send the complete application with enclosures endorsed as required before the stated last date
existing.selection_notes: Candidates are evaluated on a weighted scale taking into account the relevance of the area of study, the proposed research plan, academic records, achievements and past work experience, followed by an interview by a Selection Committee constituted by the Council. The Committee may conduct telephonic or teleconferencing interviews, and overseas candidates may be interviewed by Council-identified experts based in their own country.
existing.best_fit: Master's-level holders of Agriculture and Allied Sciences from India and overseas who want to complete a three-year PhD in an ICAR-identified priority area at an Indian Agricultural University, or Indian candidates wanting to study at an identified overseas institution.
existing.notes: The award is bidirectional: Indian nationals may apply to study abroad and overseas nationals may apply to study in India. The fellowship monetary amount is not published in the call document text available to this review, so no figure is claimed.
existing.application_period: Annual. Applications are invited on an annual basis through announcements published in Indian national newspapers and the notification on the ICAR website, with Indian diplomatic missions informed by email. For 2026 the deadline was 25 September 2026.
existing.deadline_display: Official wording for the 2026 cycle: "The application should be submitted by September 25, 2026" and "Last date for submission of the application is September 25, 2026." That date has passed. The guidelines state applications are invited annually.
existing.program_type: International doctoral research fellowship in agriculture and allied sciences
